takes.text: A landscape photograph: an establishing shot from high above, the land laid out below all the way to the horizon, of a deep forested valley seen from above its rim, in full autumn, the colours turned to red, orange and gold. Far below, tiny in the land: a stone farmhouse with smoke rising from its chimney. It is the blue hour, everything in deep blue twilight, with fast low clouds racing over and sudden bursts of sun. Shot on a large-format camera, sharp from the nearest stone to the far horizon, true natural colours.

takes.text: A landscape photograph: an establishing shot from high above, the land laid out below all the way to the horizon, of a rocky arctic coast of ice floes and dark water, in arctic autumn, the low plants turned red and gold. Far below, tiny in the land: a musk ox standing in the wind. It is a dark night, the land lit only by a faint glow in the sky, with low mist lying in the hollows. Shot on a large-format camera, sharp from the nearest stone to the far horizon, true natural colours.
